say: You can pay through our automated phone payment line: 📞 866-552-5484 It supports check-by-phone (ACH) payments. A few things to know before you call: • You must be an authorized signer on the bank account • Payments may be drafted from your account as early as today • If a check-by-phone payment is returned unpaid, a $25 returned-payment fee (or as allowable by law) applies You'll receive a confirmation number at the end — keep it for your records.
